long_biography.plain_text:
Property developer Tom Lewis approached Broward Marine as a potential marina site, then decided the struggling manufacturer deserved another chance. After acquiring its assets in 2005, he rehired its former human resources officer to help bring experienced employees back. He also reopened the repair and refit operation, aiming to restore a working business around the established name.

Lewis brought methods from property development into the yard, introducing computerised cost accounting and project management while commissioning new designs. The venture exposed him to a different production cycle: an unsold completed yacht tied up capital, while another customer's halted payments forced the business to finance unfinished work. Construction stopped in 2008, showing the financial limits of the revival he had attempted.
